breakage_notes: With the Celesto Cloud free trial limited to one retained sandbox, launching five concurrent create calls resulted in HTTP 429 rate-limit responses for the 2nd through 5th calls after the first succeeded. The local open-source runtime (which has no multi-tenant limits) ran all five in parallel without errors; total wall-clock time was 34% less than sequential. Name collisions were not observed because each sandbox name is generated from a UUID prefix. Shared-state risk: none, because each sandbox has its own isolated disk. Recommended approach for production: use the local runtime or a paid Celesto top-up that allows up to 10 concurrent sandboxes.
